title: Symphony No. 2 in C minor ("Resurrection" / Auferstehung)

movements.title_de: I. Allegro maestoso. Mit durchaus ernstem und feierlichem Ausdruck
movements.title_zh: 第一乐章：庄严的快板（葬礼 / Totenfeier）
movements.pause_after_note_zh: 乐章结束后遵照马勒总谱指示：必须保持至少五分钟的庄严静默
movements.pause_after_note_en: Score instruction at close: A pause of at least 5 minutes must follow the first movement

movements.title_de: II. Andante moderato. Sehr gemächlich. Nie eilen
movements.title_zh: 第二乐章：中庸的行板，非常从容，切勿匆忙
movements.title_en: II. Andante moderato. Very leisurely. Never rush

movements.title_zh: 第三乐章：在平静流动的律动中（圣安东尼向鱼传道）
movements.title_en: III. In quietly flowing motion (St. Anthony's Sermon to the Fishes)

movements.title_zh: 第四乐章：“原光”（Urlicht）——极其庄严而质朴
movements.title_en: IV. "Urlicht" (Primal Light). Very solemn, but simple

movements.title_de: V. Im Tempo des Scherzo. Wild herausfahrend — "Aufersteh'n"
movements.title_zh: 第五乐章：谐谑曲速度，狂野迸发——“复活”终曲
movements.title_en: V. In the tempo of the Scherzo. Bursting forth wildly — "Resurrection"
